# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by backend/scripts/gen_config_reference.py from backend/src/automl_agent/config.py.
     Do not edit by hand. -->

All settings are read from environment variables or from `backend/.env` (or a repository-root `.env`).
Names are case-insensitive; the environment variable is the upper-case field name.
Copy [`.env.example`](https://github.com/VioniX37/VX04/blob/main/.env.example) to get started.

Settings can also be overridden per command:

* CLI: `automl-agent --set N_PLANS=2 run ...`
* Benchmarks: the `settings` block of a config file, per-variant `settings`, or `--set KEY=VALUE`.


## LLM (Gemini)

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LLM_PROVIDER` | `gemini` \| `fake` | `gemini` | `gemini` for real runs, `fake` for the offline deterministic backend. |
| `GEMINI_API_KEY (or GOOGLE_API_KEY)` | `str \| None` | — | Google AI Studio API key (`GOOGLE_API_KEY` is accepted as an alias). |
| `GEMINI_MODEL_SMART` | `str` | `gemini-3.8-flash` | Model for reasoning-heavy roles: Manager and Operation Agent. |
| `GEMINI_MODEL_FAST` | `str` | `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` | Model for high-volume roles: Prompt, Data and Model agents. |
| `GEMINI_FALLBACK_MODELS` | `list[str]` | `['gemini-3.7-flash', 'gemini-3.6-flash', 'gemini-3.5-flash']` | Models tried in order when a model is overloaded (503) or out of quota (429); comma-separated. Empty disables fallback. |
| `GEMINI_OVERLOAD_WAIT_S` | `int` | `600` | While every model in the chain is overloaded, keep retrying (waiting between rounds) for up to this many seconds before failing the run. |
| `GEMINI_USE_VERTEXAI` | `bool` | `False` | Use Vertex AI instead of the Gemini Developer API. |
| `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT` | `str \| None` | — | GCP project id (Vertex AI mode only). |
| `GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION` | `str` | `global` | GCP region (Vertex AI mode only). |
| `GEMINI_RPM_SMART` | `int` | `5` | Requests-per-minute cap for the smart model. |
| `GEMINI_RPM_FAST` | `int` | `15` | Requests-per-minute cap for the fast model. |
| `GEMINI_MAX_CONCURRENCY` | `int` | `2` | Max simultaneous in-flight Gemini requests. |
| `GEMINI_MAX_RETRIES` | `int` | `6` | Retries on 429/5xx with exponential backoff. |
| `LLM_TEMPERATURE` | `float` | `0.2` | Sampling temperature for all agents. |
| `LLM_CACHE` | `bool` | `True` | Cache LLM responses on disk (reproducible, saves quota). |
| `LLM_CACHE_ROOT` | `Path \| None` | — | Cache location (default: the workspace llm_cache folder); shareable across workspaces. |
| `LLM_CACHE_NAMESPACE` | `str` | `default` | Cache partition; change it (e.g. per seed) to force fresh responses. |
| `AGENT_FUSION` | `bool` | `False` | Merge the Data and Model agent calls into one call per plan (halves calls). |
| `SEARCH_GROUNDING` | `bool` | `True` | Retrieve web knowledge through Gemini's Google Search grounding tool. |

## Pipeline

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `N_PLANS` | `int` | `3` | Number of candidate plans per planning round. |
| `MAX_REVISIONS` | `int` | `2` | Extra planning rounds when requirements are not met. |
| `MAX_DEBUG_ATTEMPTS` | `int` | `3` | Operation Agent run/fix attempts per plan. |
| `EXEC_TIMEOUT_S` | `int` | `1800` | Hard timeout for one full-data training script. |
| `CODEGEN_MODE` | `llm` \| `template` | `llm` | `llm`: Operation Agent edits the template; `template`: run the template as-is. |
| `VERIFICATION_MODE` | `pseudo` \| `grounded` | `grounded` | `pseudo`: rank plans on LLM-predicted scores (paper-faithful); `grounded`: successive halving with real runs on growing data subsamples. |
| `GROUNDING_MIN_ROWS` | `int` | `20000` | Training rows used at the first grounding rung. |
| `GROUNDING_GROWTH` | `int` | `4` | Factor by which training rows grow between rungs. |
| `GROUNDING_ETA` | `int` | `2` | Keep the best 1/eta of plans after each rung. |
| `GROUNDING_VALID_ROWS` | `int` | `100000` | Validation rows used to score grounding runs. |
| `MEMORY_ENABLED` | `bool` | `True` | Experience memory: reuse plans, scores and fixes from past runs on similar data. |
| `MEMORY_K` | `int` | `3` | Number of similar past runs recalled as planning knowledge. |
| `MEMORY_EXCLUDE_SAME_DATASET` | `bool` | `False` | Never recall runs on the same dataset (set true for leave-one-dataset-out evaluation). |
| `BUDGET_WALL_S` | `int` | `0` | Wall-clock budget per run in seconds (0 = unlimited). |
| `BUDGET_LLM_CALLS` | `int` | `0` | LLM call budget per run (0 = unlimited). |
| `BUDGET_TOKENS` | `int` | `0` | LLM token budget per run (0 = unlimited). |
| `EXEC_MAX_MEM_MB` | `int` | `0` | Kill a training script above this resident memory (MB); 0 = 80% of system RAM. |
| `EXEC_N_JOBS` | `int` | `-1` | CPU threads for model training (-1 = all cores). |

## Data

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MAX_UPLOAD_MB` | `int` | `5120` | Largest accepted browser upload (MB). |
| `ALLOW_PATH_REGISTRATION` | `bool` | `True` | Allow registering datasets by server-side file path (disable on shared servers). |
| `SPLIT_VALID_FRACTION` | `float` | `0.15` | Share of rows in the validation split. |
| `SPLIT_TEST_FRACTION` | `float` | `0.15` | Share of rows in the held-out test split. |
| `SPLIT_SEED` | `int` | `42` | Seed for the train/valid/test assignment. |
| `PROFILE_SAMPLE_ROWS` | `int` | `100000` | Rows sampled for text/identifier detection. |

## Storage and server

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `WORKSPACE_DIR` | `Path` | `<backend>/workspace` | Datasets, runs, database, cache. |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | `list[str]` | `['http://localhost:3000']` | Origins allowed to call the API. |
